image_description: A collection of four hand-knitted wool socks arranged on a light-colored surface. The socks feature variegated yarns in earth tones (rust, brown, green, cream) with distinct color-blocking and striping patterns. One sock stands upright on the right, displaying a ribbed cuff and heel turn. Another lies flat at the bottom left showing a pom-pom detail on the toe. Two others are bunched in the background. The texture is visibly coarse and fibrous, consistent with wool.

The ribbing on the cuff warps slightly inconsistently around the circumference, suggesting minor geometric generation errors in the cylindrical projection.
